message.content: Proposed 2 changes — review the inline preview, then Accept or Reject.

patch.title: Reorganize the figure copyright notes in figures.tex into a consistent, standardized format (a "Copyright and permission status" list) and make the caption wording consistent, without inventing any new license/source details.
